Team —

We just finished the 9:00am demo for Acme and hit a burst of 500s when the customer tested variant routing (multi-variant routing -> quantized fallback). Sam saw repeated errors on the second generation (~10:06am PST) and had to stop.

Quick details: demo session id: demo-acme-20260816-09; attached are the session logs and a screenshot of the console 500. Customer is very sensitive here — they indicated this blocks the POC progress.

Ask: can Platform/Runtime triage immediately and propose a temporary escape hatch we can use in the API/request to bypass the new meta-routing path? If we can provide a short-lived header/query toggle we can instruct the customer to use it and continue the demo while we fix the root cause.

Marissa — can you hold Sam and Acme integrations looped with the mitigation? Sean — please help prioritize rollback/runbook review. Dev — any early signals you want us to collect from the logs?

Thanks — extremely time sensitive.

— Aditya

Subject: Re: URGENT: demo failure — prod demo hit 500s when switching model variants

Quick update from runtime team — I dug into the logs and traces for demo-acme-20260816-09. Summary:
- Root cause signal: 500s originate from meta_routing_v2 path failing to select compatible quantized kernels for the variant at sequence length ~2.5k (looks like a kernel mismatch in the new selector).
- Failure window: 10:05:30 -> 10:07:10 PST.
- Impact: ~18% of requests in that session returned 500s, rest passed via fallback but with higher latency.

Temporary escape hatch: we can add a request header that forces the legacy routing table at request-time without a code rollback. Implementation is trivial on the gateway: header X-RW-ROUTE: legacy (case-insensitive). We'll roll a hotfix rule to check header and route to meta_routing_v1.

Example curl to send to customer:
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-RW-ROUTE: legacy" \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-3b"}'

I'll propose the following plan:
1) Hotfix gateway rule to honor header — deploy in 10 minutes (10:30am expected).
2) Share header example with customer and ask them to retry demo.
3) Keep meta_routing_v2 disabled on the demo region until we have a patch and test.

Notes/risks: this header bypass will skip some of the new routing telemetry — we'll want to capture a trace id and logs for any request using the header. I'll add trace capture for header users.

— Dev
Dev Patel

Sam —

Really sorry again for the interruption. Dev has identified the issue and we have a short-term workaround you can use while we patch: add the header X-RW-ROUTE: legacy to requests during the demo.

Steps for Acme test team (one-liner):
- Browser / Postman: add header key X-RW-ROUTE with value legacy
- CLI example: curl -H "X-RW-ROUTE: legacy" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"<your prompt>"}'

We're rolling the gateway rule now and expect the header behavior to be live in ~10m. Please try a single generation after 10:50am PST and give us the exact trace id if anything still 500s. I attached the session logs for your reference.

I'll follow up with a postmortem and patch ETA. Thanks for your patience — we want this POC to succeed.

— Aditya
